Now I understand the flow. When a vCard parameter has a structured value kind (like `TYPE` with structured values), the parser calls `vcardparameter_set_value_from_string` which calls `vcardstructured_new_from_string(val)`. If the value has more than 20 semicolon-separated fields, it overflows the `field[20]` array.
